[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Put failure accounting and bounded selection policy in Rust[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]retry-policy[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]retry-policy: extend publication recovery wire types, centralize error [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]classes and attempt charging, and implement deterministic bounded [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]request selection with binding tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Terminate interrupted Git transfers and restore publication [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]paths[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]timeout-cleanup[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]timeout-cleanup: make streaming Git cancellation kill and reap its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]process group, let the drain alarm escape broad handlers, clean prompts [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and artifacts, and verify existing stale-lock recovery.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Apply failure scope and bounded selection to commit drains[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]drain-accounting[dim] · [dim][/dim]after retry-policy, timeout-cleanup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]drain-accounting: thread structured failure provenance and selected [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]logical keys through the transaction, charge only attempted hood [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]requests, preserve timeout stage, and cap background drain batches.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Load expensive inventory data only for requested hoods[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]inventory-scope[dim] · [dim][/dim]after drain-accounting[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]inventory-scope: filter indexed, dismissed, and historical records [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before payload hydration or per-commit Git calls, reuse commit records [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]within a drain, and prove selected-hood equivalence.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Render selected hoods and their affected browsing indexes[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]payload-scope[dim] · [dim][/dim]after inventory-scope[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]payload-scope: produce targeted page payloads while preserving complete [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]manifests and indexes, keep strict validation, reuse unchanged validated[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]metadata within a transaction, and extend the read-only profiler.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Expose bounded retries without full reconciliation[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bounded-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after payload-scope[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bounded-cli: add retry limit and error-class options, use Rust selection[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]under the outbox lock, drain only the bounded request set, and document [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]queue isolation and resume behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Repair verified stale explicit manifest entries[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]manifest-repair[dim] · [dim][/dim]after retry-policy[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]manifest-repair: extend explicit local-owner manifest repair to verified[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stale file lists, retain corrupt-candidate diagnostics, and prove [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]idempotence and owner isolation.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Build and prove the backup-first stale-replay recovery [/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]procedure[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]replay-recovery[dim] · [dim][/dim]after bounded-cli, manifest-repair[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]replay-recovery: add an explicit resumable recovery helper that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]preserves unpublished owner data and objects, regenerates conflicting [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]browsing pages over upstream, and proves lossless replay in real-Git [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fixtures.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Repair Apollo and prove bounded publication on both hosts[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]recovery-proof[dim] · [dim][/dim]after replay-recovery[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]recovery-proof: verify installed revisions, preserve unique Apollo [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]content before repairing the stale replay and manifest mismatch, run [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]small publication canaries on both hosts, and publish acceptance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]evidence for the land agent.[/#D7D7AF]
